key_insight: EdgeDAM introduces a distractor-aware memory design that removes heavy segmentation and attention-driven mask prediction, enabling accurate single-object tracking with much lower compute so it can run in real time on mobile/edge devices.
problem_solved: Bridges the gap between high-accuracy distractor-aware SOT methods (which are segmentation- and attention-heavy) and the compute/latency constraints of resource-limited mobile devices, enabling robust tracking under occlusion, distractors, and fast motion.
method: Proposes EdgeDAM, a lightweight distractor-aware memory architecture tailored for edge inference that avoids costly mask prediction and attention updates.
Applies compact feature encoding and efficient memory-update rules to maintain target identity across frames while minimizing computation and memory footprint.
Optimizes model components and inference flow for low-latency deployment on mobile CPUs/NPUs without sacrificing tracking robustness.
impact: Makes state-of-the-art distractor-aware single-object tracking feasible on mobile and embedded platforms, unlocking real-time applications in AR, robotics, and on-device surveillance where latency and energy are critical.
